name: Philemon
summary: A dearly loved fellow worker of Paul, with a church meeting in his house. Paul wrote to him asking him to take back his servant Onesimus as a beloved brother.

key_moments.title: Asked to Receive Onesimus as a Brother
key_moments.description: Paul sent Onesimus back to Philemon and begged him to receive him not as a servant but as a brother beloved, as he would receive Paul himself. Paul wrote that if Onesimus had wronged him or owed him anything, Paul would repay it.
